purpose: The offer calendar the strategy brief reads (E.B28): each offer's status over a window, and the points a card must not make while it is in force because they would undercut it (do_not_undercut). A card whose point, title or takeaway makes one of those points is held until the window ends, with the offer named, and carries a blocking flag at Gate 1. Statuses: open (on sale now), waitlist (sold through the waitlist), delivering (sold or given and being delivered; not on sale), closed (not on sale). An entry without dates holds until it is changed.
source: Knowledge-base documents 05 (offers, access routes) and 14 (the content plan for 19 October to 1 November: the 2026 audit giveaway closed on 16 October and its audits run from late October to early November); the revision 7.3 finding that an angle about outgrowing one-off audits must not run while the giveaway audits are being delivered. Read by the engineer under D12; WIA confirms or corrects it at its next content-plan review.
